calculation.description: Fade each asset's three-day return relative to the cross-asset median, activated only when at least half the universe has negative five-day returns and scaled by stress intensity. Cross-sectional z-scoring is performed daily.

validation.regime_notes: Daily ICIR passed in all-sample validation; regime daily IC/ICIR: 2020-2022 +0.0162602/+0.0449935 (63 dates), 2023-2024 +0.0437040/+0.1196643 (33 dates), 2025-2027 +0.0524626/+0.1658903 (38 dates). Early regime stability is weaker; use conservative weighting. Five-day result has only 9 observations and is informational.
